A_V: Dimming of visible light (550 nm) by the dust
L: Length of the path through the gas
N_H: Number of hydrogen atoms in a column 1 cm² across along the path
f: Share of the visible light let through
f_0: Frequency of the 21 cm line at rest
f_m: Measured frequency of a radio wave
n: Number of hydrogen atoms per cubic centimeter
v: Speed of the cloud away from us
